title: E-GMT-0031: the warp factor has an exact closed form, a cubic: the {3,4,3,4} cone-type transfer matrix...
purpose: Experiment E-GMT-0031 in the geometry arena: the warp factor has an exact closed form, a cubic: the {3,4,3,4} cone-type transfer matrix [[15,11,9],[4,4,3],[0,1,2]] (read from one shell-four build) has characteristic polynomial lambda^3 - 21 lambda^2 + 51 lambda - 23 = 0, whose largest root 18.2787 is the growth rate, degree three (irreducible), and the recurrence 21,-51,23 reproduces shell five (2800344) and predicts shell six with no enumeration.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
